basis.manual: Sepehran Airlines B737 Classic FCOM D6-27370-300/400/500-SHI
basis.scope: ISDU Display Selector, System Selector, BRT, key entry; reference-only

displayFormat.note: FCOM calls the two informational fields top and bottom lines; the owner-approved front-end presents two side-by-side fields. This JSON does not command modification of approved UI geometry.

behavior: All ISDU data-display lights and MSU lamps illuminate momentarily
10 second self-test after momentary lamp illumination
TEST.data: all-segment lamp/self-test pattern, not navigation data

notes: True course over the ground, not aircraft nose heading
Actual position requires a valid aligned IRS navigation solution

duringAlignment.remainingMinutes: display 10 until time remaining is 9 minutes, then count down in one-minute intervals

simulatorOwnerOverride.authority: project owner observed equipment behavior; deliberate divergence from cited FCOM 2020 upper display ceiling
simulatorOwnerOverride.thresholdPolicy: If valid alignment time remaining is more than 6 minutes show 7, even for 7/8/9/10/17 minute remaining; at exactly 6:00 switch to 6, then 5, 4, 3, 2, 1; do not display 0 as countdown.
simulatorOwnerOverride.requires: HDG/STS selected; corresponding L or R IRS actively aligning with valid remaining time; powered; no temporary keypad/test display override
doNotShow: fast realignment unless separate specific evidence
simulatorOwnerOverride.preserveHistoricalFcomValue: The cited 2020 FCOM explicitly states a 10 minute ceiling (shows 10 until 9); simulator uses 7 only because of the owner's explicit instruction.

notes: True heading differs from true track

keyboard.overrideDisplay: Present-position or magnetic-heading keyboard entry overrides selected display temporarily
keyboard.numericInput: Present position allowed when ALIGN illuminated; magnetic heading when mode selector ATT

ENT.whiteCue: when N/S/E/W entries are being keyed
ENT.action: submit keyed data after valid reasonableness check

CLR.action: clear unentered/unaccepted data and extinguish cue when lit

futureIntegration.mustNotFabricateLiveNav: Show invalid/blank/unknown unless a valid connected IRS data source exists
